description: Tick rwx boxes for user/group/other — or type 755 — and see octal, symbolic, and the chmod command live.

faqs.a: Yes — setuid, setgid, and the sticky bit are included and shown as the 4th octal digit.
Type any 3- or 4-digit octal (e.g. 644) and the checkboxes update instantly.
faqs.q: Can I type an octal number?

faqs.a: Yes — paste something like rwxr-xr-x and the octal value appears.
The exact shell command (e.g. chmod 755 file) is shown for copy-paste.
faqs.q: Does it show the chmod command?

howto: Tick the rwx boxes, or type an octal/symbolic value.
title: chmod Calculator
